capabilities: Proofread selected text, the current paragraph, or the full document with an LLM
Insert suggested additions as highlights and removals as strikethroughs
Accept or reject suggestions via commands and hotkeys, per selection or one at a time
Connect to OpenAI, Google, Mistral, OpenRouter, or a local Ollama model
extras: API use incurs per-usage costs (the README estimates ~$0.01–$0.06 per 10,000 words and links a cost-tracking page); a free local option via Ollama avoids the API key. A CSS snippet is provided to style changes like word-processor suggested changes. PRs adding new LLM providers are welcomed.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI proofreading that shows suggested changes inline in the editor the way word processors do.

relations.evidence: This plugin requires an API key from one of the supported providers (OpenAI, Google, Mistral, or OpenRouter)
Alternatively, you can use a local model via Ollama, which requires no API key.

requires.name: OpenAI, Google, Mistral, or OpenRouter API key
Ollama running locally with a downloaded model

summary: AI proofreading plugin that inserts grammar and style corrections as inline highlights and strikethroughs you accept or reject with hotkeys.
